detail.title: GS365SB Dual HiFi Soundbar Speaker with LED Lighting - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS365SB is a dual-driver HiFi soundbar built around two 5W speakers for a combined 10W of clear, surge-free stereo sound across highs, mids and bass. Its slim horizontal form factor sits neatly under a monitor or laptop screen, saving desk space while still delivering full, room-filling audio for games, movies, music and calls. Multi-colour LED lighting runs along the body for a subtle glow that complements any setup, and a rugged metal mesh housing keeps the unit durable for daily use. Simply plug in through the 3.5mm AUX port and power via USB to connect with a desktop, laptop, MacBook, tablet, monitor or mobile phone.
